abilities.name: Phalanx Ward
abilities.description: Requires a Polearm and 2 Grit (35s recast, 12s duration, Self). Boosts Block Rate, Damage Taken reduction, Enmity, and Knockback Immunity, and arms 1 Heavy Brace that sharply reduces the next hit, fills Grit to 5, inflicts a 2s Stun and Exposed Guard, and adds a 4s Silence against spells.

abilities.name: Iron Counterstance
